ballots.name: Dana
ballots.reason: We should inform the customer of the duplicate-charge bug and ask about a two-week delay before deciding the launch plan, since the proposed safeguards remain unverified.

ballots.name: Ravi
ballots.reason: The customer's informed answer on delay tolerance is essential input, and deciding now would mean shipping a known, undisclosed payment-correctness bug with no live detection.

ballots.name: Mei
ballots.reason: This motion formalizes exactly what I committed to doing—disclose the bug to the customer and ask about delay tolerance—so we can reconvene with the information needed to make a responsible decision.
